display_name: Hash-bound structural code index for model query tools
validation_rules: built only from accepted, hash-verified CPG, tree-sitter and binary-triage artifacts of this run; never from a fresh tool run or target text
call resolution is reachability.CallGraph's; unresolved calls are escape rows with their reason, never dropped
fields the sources do not carry (inheritance, method references) are recorded as gaps, never invented
the database is re-derived from the bound inputs on every validate and compared row for row (content_sha256)
query results are locators and untrusted data that require source dereference before citation
